εὐνὴν: εὐνή — bed, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg.
εὐνῆς: εὐνή — bed, couch; fem. gen. sg.

θείοιο: θεῖος — divine, godlike; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)

θρόνον: θρόνος — chair, seat of honour; masc. acc. sg.
θρῃκῶν: Θρῄξ — a Thracian; masc. gen. pl., epic Θρῃκῶν (= Attic Θρᾳκῶν)

οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even

οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)

παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
πείρατα: πεῖραρ — end, limit, boundary; neut. acc. pl. (πείρατα γαίης ’the ends of the earth’)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περιχώσατο: περιχώομαι — be greatly angered (at, over + gen.); aor. 3 sg. mid.
πολυπίδακα: πολυπίδαξ — of many springs (πολύς + πίδαξ ’spring’); adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg., epithet of Ida
πολυπίδακος: πολυπίδαξ — many-springed, rich in springs; fem. gen. sg., epithet of Ida
πολυφόρβου: πολύφορβος — much-nourishing, giving much food; fem. gen. sg. (2 endings), agreeing with γαίης
ποσὶν: πούς — foot; masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
ποταμοῖο: ποταμός — river; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πουλυβότειραν: πουλυβότειρα — much-nourishing, bounteous; fem. acc. sg., epic (= πολυβότειρα), epithet of the earth
πρέσβα: πρέσβα (poet. fem. of πρέσβυς) — eldest, first in rank; august, revered; fem. nom./voc. sg., in apposition to a goddess’s name
προπάροιθεν: προπάροιθεν — before, in front of; prep. + gen. (also adv.)
προσέειπε: προσεῖπον — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic προσεῖπε)
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσεβήσετο: προσβαίνω — go up to, step onto; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic -σετο (cf. Attic προσέβη): ’mounted, stepped onto’
προσεφώνεε: προσφωνέω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg., augmented (προσ- + ἐ-φώνεε): ’was speaking to, addressed’
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’)
πρῶτον: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’first’
πυκινὰς: πυκινός — thick, close-packed, dense; fem. acc. pl.
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; masc. acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς before a following enclitic (οἱ): ’lest somehow’ · also accented before the enclitic με, softening a statement: ’somehow, rather’ (μάλα πώς με ’very much, somehow, me’)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’ · also gen. sg. after ἄρξομαι: ’from you’ (σέο … ἄρξομαι ’I shall begin from you’) · also gen. sg. after ἕξεται: ’on you’ (σέο … ἕξεται ’will rest on you’) · also gen. sg. after ἐκ: ’from you’ (σέο δ’ ἐκ ’and from you’)
σείετο: σείω — shake, brandish; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass., epic unaugmented (= ἐσείετο): ’was shaken’
σεύατ: σεύω (mid. σεύομαι) — dart, rush, speed; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (σεύατ’ = σεύατο): ’sped, darted’
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στυγὸς: Στύξ — the Styx, the underworld river by which the gods swear their most binding oath; fem. gen. sg.
στῆ: ἵστημι — set, stand; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔστη): ’stood’
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them, their’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σφοῖσι: σφός — their own; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς), agreeing with δόμοισιν
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
τέτυκται: τεύχω — make, build, prepare; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made ready, has come to pass’ · also with a predicate noun: ’has been made, has become’ (ταμίης τέτυκται ’has been made steward’)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηθύν: Τηθύς — Tethys, wife of Oceanus; fem. acc. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’)
τοῦτό: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom. sg., accented before enclitic γε: ’this’
τρέφον: τρέφω — nourish, rear; impf. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= ἔτρεφον)
τραπείομεν: τρέπω — turn; aor. pass. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened (= Attic τραπῶμεν), hortatory: ’let us turn’
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλους: φίλος — dear, one’s own; substantival masc. acc. pl.: ’dear ones, friends’
φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)
φαεινὼ: φαεινός — shining, bright; neut. dual acc., agreeing with ὄσσε: ’the two shining (eyes)’
φεύγων: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’fleeing’
φιλότητι: φιλότης — friendship, love, affection; also sexual love; fem. dat. sg.: ἐν φιλότητι ’in love’
φιλότητος: φιλότης — friendship, love; fem. gen. sg.
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φῂς: φημί — say, speak; pres. 2 sg. (= φῄς)
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
χάριν: χάρις — grace, favour, thanks; fem. acc. sg.: ’thanks’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἴδε: ’delight, pleasure’ (οὔ τι χάριν ἴδε ’saw no delight’)
χάρμα: χάρμα — joy, delight, source of joy; neut. nom./acc. sg., in apposition · also neut. acc. sg., predicate after γενέσθαι: ’a joy’
χαλκίδα: Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a city of Euboea; fem. acc. sg. · also Χαλκίς — Chalcis, a town of Aetolia; fem. acc. sg.
χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg.: ’onto the earth’
χρόνον: χρόνος — time; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a time’
χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν), agreeing with δέπας
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
ἀΐξασα: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀλλήλων: ἀλλήλων — one another; reciprocal pron., gen. pl., after πλησίον: ’one another’ · also gen. pl., possessive, dependent on a noun: ’one another’s’ (ἀλλήλων … στήθεσσι ’one another’s chests’) · also gen. pl., governed by ἀντίον: ’one another’ (ἀντίον ἀλλήλων ’face to face with one another’) · also gen. pl. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἰθυνομένων ’as they aimed at one another’) · also gen. pl. as object of ἐφικνέομαι: ’of one another’ (ἀλλήλων ἐφίκοντο ’got hold of one another’)
ἀλόχοιο: ἄλοχος — wife, bedfellow; fem. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. mid., masc. nom. sg.: ’answering’
ἀμφεκάλυψεν: ἀμφικαλύπτω — cover round about, envelop; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (= ἀμφεκάλυψε), ν-movable: ’enveloped’
ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀντίθεον: ἀντίθεος — godlike, a match for a god; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπέχονται: ἀπέχω — hold off; mid. keep away from (+ gen.); pres. 3 pl. mid.: ’keep away from’
ἀπίθησε: ἀπιθέω — disobey (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, negated by οὐδέ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀργαλέων: ἀργαλέος — grievous, harsh, troublesome; masc. gen. pl.
ἀρηξέμεν: ἀρήγω — help, aid (+ dat.); fut. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἀρήξειν): ’to help’
ἀσκήσας: ἀσκέω — work skilfully, fashion with art; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having worked with skill’
ἀτάλαντον: ἀτάλαντος — equal in weight, matching (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg.
ἀτίταλλον: ἀτιτάλλω — foster, nurse, rear; impf. 3 pl. act.
ἀφροδίτη: Ἀφροδίτη — Aphrodite, goddess of love; fem. nom. sg.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’) · also modal particle with the subj. in a general relative clause: ’whomever’ (ὃν … ἂν … νοήσω ’whomever I notice’) · also modal particle ἄν with an infinitive in reported speech, keeping the ’would’ of the direct words: ’he said he would’ (ἂν … ἔφη παραμυθήσασθαι) · also ἂν = ἀνά before ν, prep. + acc.: ’up through’ (ἂν νέκυας ’up through the corpses’)
ἄγ: ἄγε (elided ἄγ’) — come!, come now; interjection, originally 2 sg. imper. of ἄγω ’lead’, used before another imperative
ἄγρει: ἄγρει — come now! up!; epic interjection with an imper. sense (perhaps from ἀγρέω ’take’)
ἄκοιτιν: ἄκοιτις — wife, bedfellow; fem. acc. sg.
ἄκριτα: ἄκριτος — unsorted, undistinguished, without end; neut. acc. pl.: ’unsorted, endless’
ἄκρον: ἄκρος — topmost, outermost; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun or adverb: ’the top, at the top’
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνωγας: ἄνωγα — bid, command, urge (perf. with present sense); perf. 2 sg., epic: ’you bid, you press’
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄφθιτον: ἄφθιτος — imperishable, undying; neut. acc. sg.
ἅζετο: ἅζομαι — stand in awe of, revere; impf. 3 sg. mid. dep., unaugmented: ’revered’
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἅπαντας: ἅπας — all, the whole, every; masc. acc. pl.
ἅπαντες: ἅπας — all, every one; masc. nom. pl.
ἆσσον: ἆσσον — nearer, closer; adv., comparative of ἄγχι
ἐκέλευε: κελεύω — bid, command, urge; impf. 3 sg.: ’kept bidding’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’) · also neut. voc. sg., in address: ’my’ (τέκνον ἐμὸν ’my child’)
ἐμὸς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. nom. sg., agreeing with δαήρ · also masc. nom. sg., agreeing with πάϊς: ’my own’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναλίγκιος: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρατεινὴν: ἐρατεινός — lovely, delightful; adj., fem. acc. sg.
ἐρικυδέος: ἐρικυδής — very glorious, much honoured; fem. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic -οῦς)
ἐσάωσε: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, preserve; aor. 3 sg., augmented ἐσάωσε (= Attic ἔσωσε): ’saved’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐόντες: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic ὄντες): ’being’
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑοῖο: ἑός — his own, her own (possessive, by-form of ὅς); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ἑστᾶσ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. 3 pl., elided (ἑστᾶσ’ = ἑστᾶσι, for ἑστάασι; Attic ἑστήκασι): ’they stand’
ἑτέρῃ: ἕτερος — the other (of two), one; fem. dat. sg., agreeing with χειρί: ’in one hand’
ἑῷ: ἑός (= ὅς, ἥ, ὅν possessive) — his own, her own; 3rd-pers. reflexive possessive adj., masc. dat. sg.: ’her own’
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔκλυες: κλύω — hear; aor. 2 sg., + gen.: ’you heard’
ἔμβαλε: ἐμβάλλω — throw in, put into; aor. 3 sg., + dat.: ’cast into’
ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐνέπεσε): ’fell on’
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ) · also accented ἔν before the enclitic γε (ἔν γ’ αὐτοσταδίῃ ’in close combat’)
ἔνερθε: ἔνερθε — below, beneath; prep. + gen., also adv.: ’below’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔραμαι: ἔραμαι — love, desire (+ gen.); pres. 1 sg. mid.
ἔρχομαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg.: ’I am going’ · also pres. 1 sg. with perfect force, + fut. part. of purpose: ’I have come’ (ἔρχομαι … οἰσόμενος ’I have come to fetch’)
ἔρως: ἔρως — love, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕρδοι: ἕρδω — do, perform (= Attic ῥέζω); pres. opt. 3 sg. act., in an indirect deliberation: ’should do’
ἠέρα: ἀήρ — mist, thick air; masc. acc. sg., epic ἠέρα (= Attic ἀέρα)
ἠμὲν: ἠμέν — both (epic correlative, ἠμέν … ἠδέ ’both … and’); conj.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματα: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl., acc. of time: ’all the days, every day’
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. acc. sg.: ’whom’; not the possessive · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν — her own; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’her own’ (θυγατέρα ἥν ’her own daughter’)
ἥρη: Ἥρη (Ionic/epic by-form of Ἥρα) — Hera, wife of Zeus; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form) in address: ’Hera!’
ἥφαιστος: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἧς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; fem. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (ἧς εἵνεκα ’for whose sake’) · also ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with its noun (ἧς ἀλόχοιο ’his own wife’) · also relative, fem. gen. sg., attracted into the case of its antecedent: ’which’ (τῆς … γενεῆς ἧς ’the breed which’)
ἰδέσθαι: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. mid. inf., of respect after an adjective: ’to look at’
ἱκάνω: ἱκάνω (poetic by-form of ἱκνέομαι) — come to, arrive at, reach; pres. 1 sg.
ἱκέσθην: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach; aor. 3 dual (strong aor., ἱκέσθην), + acc. of goal: ’the two came to’
ἱκοίμην: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential with κεν: ’I should come to’
ἱπποπόλων: ἱππόπολος — horse-herding, tending horses; masc. gen. pl.
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ἴδεν: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= εἶδεν)
ἴδην: Ἴδη — Mount Ida, near Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴδης: Ἴδη — Mount Ida; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἴδης)
ἴδῃ: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 sg., after ἵνα: ’you may see’ · also after ὄφρα: ’that you may see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if he should see’ · also aor. subj. act. 3 sg., after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also Ἴδη — Mount Ida, near Troy; fem. dat. sg., place where, after ἐν
ἴθ: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἴθ’ = ἴθι): ’go! come!’
ἴμβρου: Ἴμβρος — Imbros, an island in the north Aegean; fem. gen. sg.
ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
ἵμερος: ἵμερος — longing, desire; masc. nom. sg.
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἵνα τ’ ἄνδρες … τελέθουσι ’where men become’)
ὀνόμαζεν: ὀνομάζω — call by name, name; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ὠνόμαζε); with ἐκ in tmesis (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζεν) ’called by name’
ὀνόμηνεν: ὀνομαίνω — name, call by name; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (Attic ὀνομάζω): ’named’
ὀψομένη: ὁράω — see; fut. ὄψομαι; fut. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’going to see’
ὁπότ: ὁπότε (elided ὁπότ’) — when, whenever; temporal conj.
ὁπότε: ὁπότε — whenever, when; temporal conj., + opt. in a general clause · also + aor. subj. in a general temporal clause, with no κε: ’whenever’ (ὁπότε … στυφελίξῃ ’whenever it drives’) · also + pres. indic. in a simile: ’as when’ (ὡς δ’ ὁπότε … κάτεισι ’as when … goes down’)
ὁρμηθῆναι: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush forth; aor. inf. pass., in active sense: ’to rush’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὄμοσσον: ὄμνυμι — swear; aor. imper. 2 sg., epic -σσ-
ὄρεσσι: ὄρος — mountain; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ὄρεσι)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὅθι: ὅθι — where; epic relative adverb (= Attic οὗ)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’) · also + gen., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ’beneath him’) · also ὑπ’ ἐκ + gen., ’out from under’ (ὑπ’ ἐκ κακοῦ ’out from under evil’)
ὑπέρθυμος: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, of overflowing spirit (ὑπέρ + θυμός); masc. nom. sg.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’)
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’)
ὕστερον: ὕστερος — later, latter; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’afterwards’
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὠκεανόν: Ὠκεανός — Oceanus, the river encircling the earth; masc. acc. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥίον: ῥίον — crag, headland, jutting peak; neut. acc. sg.
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
